headline: Gaza ceasefire-violation toll rises to 1,602 killed and 5,794 injured
dek: Gaza's Health Ministry reported 3 Palestinians killed and 21 injured in the past 24 hours, taking the toll since the ceasefire to 1,602 killed and 5,794 injured, with 847 bodies recovered from rubble. The cumulative toll since October 2023 is 74,618 killed and 175,920 injured.
sources: Gaza Health Ministry daily statistical report, via Palestine Chronicle (citing Al Mayadeen)
fault_line: Ceasefire in name or in fact — 1,602 dead since the truce, and the two sides cannot even agree on what counts as a violation?

sections.what_happened: Gaza's Health Ministry reported 3 Palestinians killed and 21 injured in the past 24 hours, taking the toll since the ceasefire to 1,602 killed and 5,794 injured, with 847 bodies recovered from rubble. The cumulative toll since October 2023 is 74,618 killed and 175,920 injured. This is an increment of +3 killed / +20 injured on the 1,599 / 5,774 figure recorded at 1100-04 on Nov 4 (Anadolu via Yeni Safak, Tuesday's deaths). SCOPE DISCIPLINE: do not merge this ministry total with the IDF's militant-kill claims (IDF says 6 operatives killed in Gaza strikes this week, Times of Israel Nov 4) or with the ceasefire ledger's partial counts — different scopes, different sources. DATE VARIANCE: Palestine Chronicle dates the ceasefire to October 11, 2025; the Nov 4 Yeni Safak/Anadolu record dates it to October 10. Record both; do not smooth over.
sections.what_verified: No declared-tier family carries the 1,602 figure in-window. Palestine Chronicle and Al Mayadeen have no declared tier and therefore NEVER count toward corroboration, even though they relay the ministry's own count.
sections.what_disputed: The IDF's account of the same period frames its strikes as targeting operatives 'in systematic violation of the ceasefire' (Times of Israel, Nov 4: 6 operatives killed this week, including a Hamas sniper-cell commander and a Hamas military-intelligence operations chief). That is a different scope (militant kills claimed by the IDF) and does not rebut the ministry's total, but it is the strongest on-record counter-framing of what the post-truce deaths consist of.
sections.why_matters: Monitor only: a +3 increment on the already-recorded 1,599 baseline is not a new Short. A toll Short refreshes only on a new threshold crossing with named incident detail, with the scope (ministry total since truce start) stated in the headline itself per the toll-card discipline.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Gaza Health Ministry daily report, Wednesday Nov 4; surfaced in 03:00-04:00 scan; absent from 00:00/01:00/02:00/03:00 scans) — Gaza ceasefire-violation toll rises to 1,602 killed and 5,794 injured; 3 killed and 21 injured in the past 24 hours; cumulative toll 74,618 killed
